body:
Three holiday changes that took effect in 2026 were missing from the South Korean calendar:

- June 3rd, 2026 was the local election day, a public holiday on which KRX was closed (it is in the Bank of Korea's 2026 holiday list as "Regional Election").
- Constitution Day, July 17th, is a public holiday again from 2026 (Act on Public Holidays passed January 29th, Act No. 21338 of February 10th, 2026, in force May 11th; Constitution Day is also in the Bank of Korea's 2026 list). The calendar only had it until 2007.
- Labour Day (a public holiday from 2026, Act No. 21543 of April 9th, 2026) and Constitution Day now also get a substitute holiday on the following Monday when they fall on a weekend, like the other holidays that already have one (Presidential Decree No. 36290 of April 30th, 2026, amending Article 3 of the Regulation on Public Holidays of Government Offices). The 2027 calendar guidelines published on June 29th, 2026 by the Korea AeroSpace Administration list Monday May 3rd and Monday July 19th, 2027 as substitute holidays (May 1st and July 17th are Saturdays).

On master, `SouthKorea` reports all four dates as business days. The change adds the election day and the two rules to `SettlementImpl::isBusinessDay` (`KrxImpl` builds on it). The expected holiday lists of `testSouthKoreanSettlement` and `testKoreaStockExchange` are extended with the new dates up to 2050; they fail on master with 68 missing dates and pass now.

This also covers what #2685 started (that PR was closed as stale).
title: Add the 2026 Korean holiday changes: local election, Constitution Day and substitute holidays
